items.title: Render history in timeline
items.summary: The project timeline now colors 2.0 prompts yellow, renders purple, and shows prompt text plus tracked render cost metadata directly in history.

items.title: Management feedback DMs
items.summary: Admins can now ask follow-up questions from suggestion and bug reports, sending realtime chat notifications to users without refreshing the dashboard.

items.title: Shared workspaces folder
items.summary: Shared workspaces now live under a dedicated Shared workspaces group with a compact folder menu for choosing which ones appear in the project browser.

items.title: Discord authorized app linking
items.summary: Users can now link Discord from Preferences so Render bot alerts can DM them when teammates tag them in project chat.

items.title: AI setup intro
items.summary: Signed-in users without AI access now get a Render3D intro-style setup window with clear next steps to connect an API key, load shared credits, or start a tutorial.

items.title: Discord public model announcements
items.summary: When a project is pushed to Public, Render3D can now post a Discord bot announcement with the project title, creator, description, thumbnail, and public view link.

items.title: Google new-user robot walkthrough
items.summary: New Google sign-ins now pull the Google profile name and photo, then launch a Robot Arm walkthrough that introduces Generate, selection, references, Knowledge Base, Agent, and screenshots.

items.title: Skills media cards
items.summary: Skills Library cards are now a tighter square grid with animated previews, richer More Info explanations, and local GIF or short clip previews per skill.

items.title: Rigging animation banner
items.summary: Rigging animation controls now appear as a collapsible top-center banner only when a playable animation or motion source is available.

items.title: Saved screenshot options
items.summary: The viewport Screenshot button can now ask for a capture mode, save a full-window or crop preference, and reuse that setting on the next click.

items.title: Rendered texture wrapping
items.summary: Photoreal Render can now use the generated image file as a texture map, wrap it directly onto the selected model, and save a textured GLB without sending the wrap through an AI CAD prompt.

items.title: Personal and shared project destinations
items.summary: Project Explorer now labels your personal files by name, highlights shared workspaces with member counts, and can ask where to create new projects when you are working in a shared workspace.

items.title: Visual Skills Library
items.summary: Skills Library now has a visual browser with grid, list, and compact views, sortable cards, searchable previews, expanded skill details, and store links.

items.title: Render Agent Do it for me
items.summary: Render Agent now has a guided Do it for me flow that collects the desired task, project, and optional object, then explains each setup step with sticky notes before sending the request.

items.title: Loading tips and walkthrough
items.summary: Studio loading now shares practical tips and can queue an animated walkthrough that starts automatically once the editor is ready.

items.title: Send to Bambu Studio
items.summary: Export prepares a plate-ready 3MF and opens it in local Bambu Studio so the part lands on the build plate.

items.title: Realtime editor viewport popup
items.summary: Open a large realtime editor viewport from the workspace strip; after import/open it collapses to a compact left chip for the active object.

items.title: Mode 2.0 selected-face length edit
items.summary: Face and component refs keep edit mode on the viewport object so lengthen/extend revises the selected part instead of regenerating from an older baseline.

items.title: Sticky docs topic legend
items.summary: The left topic legend on Getting Started and Full Documentation stays with you while scrolling so you can jump between sections anytime.
